story: Trend Auto Trader gets a private concept homepage, not a mailed pitch. The page keeps their name in the header, puts industry photography in a 4:5 frame, and makes the next step a call or their official site. When the live site blocks the harvest, the preview stays honest and a little quieter instead of padding fake specifics.
